mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_campaign_log (tenant_id, campaign_id, mass_email_id, action, action_time, target_type, target_id, target_email, click_url, user_agent, ip_address, message_record_id, test_flag, source_event_key, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{campaignId}, #{massEmailId}, #{action}, #{actionTime}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetEmail}, #{clickUrl}, #{userAgent}, #{ipAddress}, #{messageRecordId}, #{testFlag}, #{sourceEventKey}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE log_id = log_id
mapper.select: SELECT event.action, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM crm_campaign_log event JOIN crm_mass_email_recipient recipient ON recipient.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND recipient.mass_email_id = event.mass_email_id AND recipient.campaign_id = event.campaign_id AND event.source_event_key = CONCAT('MAIL:', recipient.recipient_id, ':', event.action) WHERE event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND event.test_flag = 0 AND recipient.test_flag = 0 AND event.action IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'OPENED', 'CLICKED', 'BOUNCED', 'UNSUBSCRIBED') AND (event.action NOT IN ('OPENED', 'CLICKED', 'UNSUBSCRIBED') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_campaign_log accepted WHERE accepted.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND accepted.source_event_key = CONCAT('MAIL:', recipient.recipient_id, ':SENT') AND accepted.test_flag = 0)) AND (event.action != 'BOUNCED' OR recipient.status != 'SENT') GROUP BY event.action
SELECT * FROM crm_campaign_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND log_id = #{logId} AND archive_checked_time IS NULL AND archive_payload IS NULL AND action_time < #{cutoff} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_campaign_log SET target_email = CASE WHEN #{event.archivePayload,jdbcType=BLOB} IS NULL THEN target_email ELSE NULL END, click_url = CASE WHEN #{event.archivePayload,jdbcType=BLOB} IS NULL THEN click_url ELSE NULL END, user_agent = CASE WHEN #{event.archivePayload,jdbcType=BLOB} IS NULL THEN user_agent ELSE NULL END, ip_address = CASE WHEN #{event.archivePayload,jdbcType=BLOB} IS NULL THEN ip_address ELSE NULL END, archive_payload = #{event.archivePayload,jdbcType=BLOB}, archive_checksum = #{event.archiveChecksum,jdbcType=BINARY}, archived_time = #{event.archivedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, archive_checked_time = #{event.archiveCheckedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND log_id = #{event.logId} AND archive_checked_time IS NULL AND archive_payload IS NULL
